children: Bank al Etihad has taken a step into the UAE market after signing a MOU with Abu Dhabi-based Ethmar International Holding (EIH) and a group of UAE investors to establish a new bank in Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM).
The proposed lender will operate under a Category 1 banking licence in ADGM.
(Writing by Ahmad Mousa; editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Jordan’s Bank al Etihad expands to UAE
